headline: DGII to extend deadline for electronic invoicing
summary: The Dominican Republic's tax authority DGII will extend the deadline for micro and small taxpayers to join the electronic invoicing system. The decision followed instructions from the government, a day after it said no general extension was possible.
why: Electronic invoicing rules affect tax compliance and administrative costs for businesses, and tax administration shapes government revenue collection.
original_headline: DGII ampliará plazo para facturación electrónica
